messages:
elaine: Heads-up — partner push completed. New model bundle landed in s3: s3://redwood-artifacts/incoming/partnerX/everest-13b/2026-03-19/. Files: weights.bin, tokenizer.json, manifest.yaml, signature.sig. checksum file attached.

tim: ack. can you paste the manifest checksum and the uploader id?

elaine: manifest sha256: 4f8d2a9b7c3c1e2b5a6d9f2e3c4b7a9e6d8f1c2b3a4d5e6f7g8h9i0j1k2l3m4n  uploader: partnerX-ci@partners.com  license: apache-2.0 (manifest lists third-party debate-license.md)

ajay: moving to quick triage. priority: medium (not a customer urgent). plan: provenance checks -> smoke forward pass -> tokenization sanity -> small quant bench -> registry entry in staging. ETA for smoke: today EOD.

morgan: pls ensure KMS key is the partner ingest key and that object ACL is restricted. I saw ephemeral public-read in past pushes.

elaine: confirmed KMS: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-ef01. ACL = private.

artifact-bot: [auto] manifest YAML parsed. model_size: 13B, arch: transformer, tokenizer: bpe-online-v3, expected_vocab_size: 50280, kv_cache_compat: yes, quant_recommended: int8-dynamic.

tim: checklist reminders:
- verify weights checksum vs manifest
- run tokenizer.validate on a small corpus
- run model_info to confirm parameter count matches manifest
- run 1-step forward pass with dummy input (seq_len=8) on staging GPU
- run neonatal quant kit (nqit) int8-dynamic profile
- run eval harness on unit prompts (latency + golden outputs)

ajay: starting with checksum verify now. command I used:
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/incoming/partnerX/everest-13b/2026-03-19/manifest.yaml - | sha256sum
```
manifest matches the provided sha256. weights checksum currently verifying (large).

morgan: legal-bot, any red flags on license/third-party deps?

legal-bot: flagged_deps: [debate-license.md] -> requires review. Not blocking onboarding but need legal sign-off before production. See ticket LGL-432.

ajay: weights sha256 matches manifest after streaming checksum. starting tokenization sanity: running tokenizer.validate on 10k lines of internal corpus.

elaine: pushing a small staging cluster tag: cluster=staging-quant-1, model tag = everest-13b:staging-20260319. Do not promote until bench green + legal clear.

ajay: tokenizer.validate returns: vocab_size=50280 OK, merges parse OK, special tokens present. quick sample tokenization looks sane:
"The quick brown fox" -> [324, 19, 4021, 88]

tim: run model_info now and check param count. use python snippet:
```python
from model_utils import model_info
print(model_info('s3://.../weights.bin'))
```

ajay: model_info output: total_params=13_469_320_448 (13.47B) matches manifest. KV cache flags compatible.

ajay: forward pass smoke (seq=8, batch=2) on staging GPU:
- env: cuda11, torch1.14, runtime v2.1
- command: run_forward --weights s3://.../weights.bin --input "hello world"
result: success, latency ~45ms per token tail. logits produced, no NaNs.

morgan: run the neonatal quant kit (nqit) with the int8-dynamic profile and capture EMR for token-level perplexity delta. small config:
```yaml
nqit_profile: int8-dynamic
calibration_corpus: s3://redwood-evals/cals/short-1k.txt
metrics: [ppl, logit_stability, mse_embeddings]
```

ajay: nqit run kicked off. early results: ppl delta +0.9% vs fp16 on short set, logit_stability within threshold, embed_mse 0.0023 (good). attaching patch notes.

elaine: consensus so far: int8-dynamic looks acceptable for staging experiments. we should run full eval harness overnight on our standard eval sets before adding to staging registry.

tim: add regression checks: run the eval harness with the customer-critical prompts list (evals/critical-prompts-v2). if regression rate >1.5% rollback to fp16 baseline.

morgan: ops note — please pin rollout policy to canary=5% and autoscale off for first 24h. Also set logging retention to 30d for this model.

ajay: creating registry manifest for staging. manifest fields: model_id=everest-13b, version=20260319-staging, artifacts=[weights.bin, tokenizer.json], checksum_shas=[...], provenance_tags=[partnerX, inbound, staging-signed], signer=ingest-service.

artifact-bot: created staging registry entry everest-13b:20260319-staging (uid=mdl-0a1b2c3). Signed manifest uploaded to ledger.

morgan: who will own the debug / eval run tomorrow morning? @tim?

tim: I can take the morning shift; will check overnight eval outputs and post summary. If regressions, I'll open an incident thread and revert staging tag.

elaine: thanks all. next steps: legal to review debate-license.md, ops to keep cluster locked, ajay to run full eval overnight, tim to monitor and report. tagging ticket infra: ML-ingest-721 for the onboarding checklist.

tim: quick ask — add a small prompt set to check instruction-following quality (IF-50). I'll drop it into /evals/runs/everest-20260319/ if nobody objects.

morgan: go ahead.

elaine: done for now. tagging @artifact-bot to mark thread: staged-triage-complete.

artifact-bot: [auto] thread update: staged-triage-complete. next check: overnight evals + legal sign-off.

elaine: closing loop — please append notes to ML-ingest-721 when you finish your step :thumbsup:"
